lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately 10-12 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The density is highest in the region directly dorsal to the pectoral fin, transitioning into a sparse, more regular grid toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a clear grid-like matrix of anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light-reflecting upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries running parallel to the long axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily located along the anterior edge and the mid-section of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density patterning of smaller, irregularly spaced high-intensity points across its lateral surface, distinct from the larger blobs on the main flank.
